title: Routing: Landing page at / and canvas editor at /stream/:id
description: Set up react-router-dom with HashRouter. Route / shows the LandingPage component. Route /stream/:id loads the corresponding value stream into the graph store and shows the existing AppShell canvas view. When entering a stream, loadStream is called; when navigating away, unloadStream saves state back. This connects the landing page to the existing canvas editor seamlessly.
